name: Triangle-Triangle Intersection Test
aliases: Triangle Intersection via Separating Axes and Constructive Decisions
Triangle-Triangle Intersection Test — SAT Triangle Intersection, Separating Axis Theorem (SAT) for triangles, Separating Axis Theorem for Triangles, testIntersection
definition: A function to test if two triangles intersect using the Separating Axis Theorem (SAT). It returns 1 if they intersect and 0 if they do not.
summary: The Triangle-Triangle Intersection Test determines if two 3D triangles intersect by projecting them onto separating axes, distinguishing itself from ray-based methods by testing arbitrary triangles without a viewing direction.
